# Juan Esquivel

> Marketer based in Los Angeles. Previously Head of Marketing at StableLab (2023–2026). Working across content, brand, product, and narrative.

Juan Esquivel is a marketer specializing in brand strategy, content, product marketing, and positioning for crypto companies. He led marketing at StableLab, a DAO governance infrastructure company, through three business phases: services, product launch, and sales-led GTM. Previously, he was Content Lead at Boardroom. He writes about marketing, storytelling, and building your way in.
